title: AxionLimitBench: can AI curate a dark matter constraint repository?

creators.name: Yuan, Lanqing
creators.affiliation: Department of Physics, Washington University in St. Louis

notes: If you use AxionLimitBench, please cite it and the AxionLimits compilation that provides the reference curves.
description:
AxionLimitBench v0.1.2 adds the PDU evaluation and 100-paper agent repeatability supplement. The original 292-paper benchmark, frozen scorer, task card, six baseline arms and leaderboard definition are unchanged.

The supplement includes revised dual mass-range coverage and joint pointwise-agreement analyses, per-paper exclusions, outcome audits, table and figure reproduction, and 200 repeatability predictions and full event transcripts. Analysis and transcript archives with SHA-256 checksums are included in this release and mirrored on Hugging Face. Offline numerical reproduction was verified against the saved results. No new extraction was performed during packaging.

The companion manuscript (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22880507) has been accepted to ML4PS 2026. The revised PDU manuscript and input paper PDFs are not included.
